edit.help: Drag in the waveform to select a region, then press "Cut" (or Del). Click sets the playhead. Ctrl + mouse wheel zooms. Space = play/pause, I/O = mark in/out.
edit.title: Cut & metadata
errors.csrf: Your session expired. Please try again.

install.app_url_hint: Used for links in e-mails, RSS feeds and passkeys. Without trailing slash.
install.fix_requirements: Please fix the missing requirements first (red entries).

install.title: Installation
install.binary_path_hint: A name on the search path (e.g. "ffmpeg") or the absolute path to the executable, e.g. /usr/www/users/name/bin/ffmpeg. The check above runs again automatically when you change it.
install.hint.binary_empty: Please enter a program name or path.
install.hint.no_process: PHP is not allowed to start external programs on this server (proc_open and exec are disabled).
install.hint.binary_not_found: No file found at this path. Check the path – open_basedir may also block access.
install.hint.binary_is_directory: This is a directory. Please enter the full path to the executable (including "/ffmpeg" or "/ffprobe").
install.hint.binary_not_executable: The file is not executable. After an FTP upload, set its permissions to 755 (chmod +x).
install.hint.binary_not_on_path: Not found on the web server's search path. Please enter the absolute path to the executable.
install.hint.binary_failed: The program could not be started or did not report a version. Does the file match the server architecture (e.g. static Linux build amd64/arm64)?

js.wf.manual_hint: The pipeline pauses here until a cutter has cut the audio and filled in the metadata. Cutters are notified by e-mail if enabled.

publish.error.slug_taken: This feed slug is already in use.
publish.platform_hint: Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Amazon Music, YouTube Music and most other directories import podcasts via RSS: submit the feed URL of an "Own RSS feed" target once – new episodes appear automatically.
publish.subtitle: Where finished episodes are published automatically
publish.field.title: Podcast title
publish.field.author: Author
publish.help.rss: audiEdiPipe hosts a podcast RSS feed. Audio files are served by this server or uploaded to one of your storage locations (e.g. your web server via SFTP).
publish.help.buzzsprout: Uploads episodes via the Buzzsprout API. Find podcast ID and API token in Buzzsprout under "Settings → API Access".
publish.help.podbean: Uploads episodes via the Podbean API (client credentials). Create an app at developers.podbean.com.
publish.help.spreaker: Uploads episodes via the Spreaker API. Create an access token in the Spreaker developer settings.
publish.hint.public_base_url: Only needed when the files are stored on another storage location, e.g. https://example.com/podcast
publish.hint.storage_id: Empty: files are served by audiEdiPipe itself.
review.title: Review
settings.cron_url: Web cron URL (webspace, external cron service)
settings.logo_hint: PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG. Square or landscape logos work best.
settings.smtp_hint: Authenticated SMTP (e.g. your mail provider). Without a host, mails are only written to storage/logs/mail.log.
settings.subtitle: Application, branding, e-mail and system
settings.test_mail_body: This is a test message from audiEdiPipe. Your SMTP settings work.
settings.test_mail_logged: No SMTP server configured – the mail to {to} was written to storage/logs/mail.log.
settings.worker_done: Worker finished: {stages} stage(s) processed, {imported} new file(s) imported.
settings.worker_hint: The worker scans storage locations and processes pipeline stages. Run it every minute via cron, systemd (bin/console worker:loop) or an external web cron.

sources.hint.public_key: Optional but recommended: protects against man-in-the-middle attacks. Leave empty to trust any host key.
sources.hint.share: Name of the share, e.g. "audio" for \\server\audio
